Seam with R10-ORCH-MACHINERY: the beat's handoff job honours the same hold file, and R10-FLOW-ROSTER-FREEZE writes it automatically while a reviewer is live.
brief: A hold list the relay honours, so a frozen pull request's head stays put while its handoff branch keeps moving (Lean flow study K13a; expedite since revision 5). cloud_relay.sh's handoff arm updates every open pull request whose handoff/<topic> tip is ahead of its head, and has no hold or exclusion option. The round's roster pull request takes its topic from handoff/audit-r10-roster, the branch every roster_edit.py push lands on, so the roster freeze had to stop all roster pushes, forward-carries included; finding-propagation.md needs a fixer's carry on that branch before its pull request merges, and fix-review.md step 10 checks it at the body's handoff/audit-r<N>-roster sha (2026-10-21: #2567 blocked carry-missing behind the freeze). Add a hold file under the relay's state directory: a pull request number listed there is skipped by the handoff arm with one HELD line per pass, naming the handoff tip it did not apply; removing the number resumes it. The orchestrator writes and removes it; nothing else does. With a pull request held, roster pushes, forward-carries included, continue on the handoff branch and are taken up by the next roster pull request after the held one merges. Controls: a held pull request whose handoff tip moved is not updated and prints HELD; an unheld one is updated as today; a malformed hold file is a refusal for that pass, never a silent hold-all or hold-none; mutants for each arm.
